selected_branches.branch: Highway-side parking on a narrow road.

law_text: A person shall not stop, stand or park a vehicle, except when necessary to avoid conflict with other traffic or in compliance with law or the directions of a police officer or official traffic-control device, in any of the following places: On the highway side of any vehicle stopped or parked at the edge of or curb of a highway.

runtime_uncertainties: Original highway, curb and side-by-side vehicle placement require local physical review.
Stop, stand or park activity and exceptions require independent source and legal review.

evidence_review.method: Reviewed every frozen evidence inventory entry and its local accepted metadata; compared case identities and acceptance fields only. Physical equivalence and branch coverage remain unresolved.

gaps.requirement: Original highway-side relationship, stop/stand/park activity and exception circumstances
gaps.why_existing_insufficient: Frozen evidence inventory contains zero accepted recordings.

witness_review.branch: Highway-side parking on a narrow road.
required_context: Actual halt purpose, activity and all exception circumstances.
Both covered vehicles' dimensions, positions and orientations.
Construct a supported parking approach and endpoint, highway edge or curb, and the other vehicle's stopped or parked position.
Establish highway status, responsible person and covered characteristics of both vehicles.
Highway boundaries, dedication and public access.
Observe both vehicles concurrently, including orientation, motion, halt purpose and actual activity.
Other vehicle stopped or parked at the edge or curb, with ego on its highway side.
Retain traffic-conflict circumstances, applicable law and police or official-device directions.
Supported narrow-road parking route and target.
witness_review.reason: A narrow road can support the specified parking relationship; neither narrowness nor the other vehicle alone establishes activation.

requirement_dispositions.requirement: NRS-484B-450-1l highway side of a vehicle stopped or parked at highway edge or curb; stop, stand, park and each stated exception
requirement_dispositions.evidence_or_gap: No accepted original recording; eight exact captures and seven controlled comparisons required.
